serialize.name: serialize
serialize.description: The indicated message part will be serialized to disk if possible. Combination of messagepart=ALL and serialize=true will serialize ConnectMessage to disk.

filename-extension.name: filename-extension
filename-extension.description: Expand the file name with this extension. The default is no extension.

filename-generator.name: filename-generator
filename-generator.description: Reference to a Java class implementing MyESBFileNameGenerator to generate the file name. The default value is DefaultMyESBFileNameGenerator which will generate a file name by combining file_name-from-header with file_name-extension.

messagepart.name: messagepart
messagepart.description: Name of the MessagePart in the incoming ConnectMessage that is to be used by this component.

directory.name: directory
directory.description: Path to the directory where the file is written to

filename-from-header.name: filename-from-header
filename-from-header.description: Use the content of this header attribute as the file name. File-consumer and FTP-consumer will set original file name in header attribute file_name. Default header attribute for file_name is connectmessageID.
